newsitem.title: USA: J & J Snack to recall some pretzel sticks.
newsitem.headline: J & J Snack to recall some pretzel sticks.

text.p: J & J Snack Foods Corp said on Friday it is recalling frozen "Superpretzel Softstix" cheese-filled soft pretzel sticks in cheddar flavor, because they may contain undeclared peanut butter and jelly spread.
The company said that people who have allergies to peanuts run the risk of serious or life-threatening allergic reaction it they consume these products.

Frozen, cheddar cheese-filled Softstix were distributed through retail supermarkets. The company said the areas possibly affected include North and South Dakota, Nebraska, Kansas, Minnesota, Iowa, Wisconsin, Illinois, Missouri, Michigan, Indiana, Kentucky, West Virginia, Ohio, Western Pennsylvania, Upstate New York, Vermont, New Hampshire, and Maine. The company said that no illnesses or allergic reactions had been reported to date, although there had been several reports of the mislabeled product.

The recall was initiated after two consumer calls were received indicating the presence of peanut butter and jelly spread instead of cheddar cheese filling, the company said. Investigation revealed that about 100 cases (1,200 individual boxes) were inadvertently packed with peanut butter and jelly spread filling.
